Name: Replaces Horses With Bikes
Author: scarolinebirch
Description:
Replaces the default brown horse with a bicycle, and changes the horse stable to a shed more suitable to a bike.  

Changes in 1.1:
- slight change to sprites
- changes descriptive text in Robin's shop

Known problems:
- the bike will still play the horse galloping noise when ridden (working on this - if anyone knows what specific audio file in Wave_Bank.xwb the noise is stored in, let me know.  I'm having trouble finding it manually.)
- The "your horse is wonders where you've been" message when returning from the desert still refers to a horse; I plan on changing this eventually but I'm not sure what file I need to be looking for- if anyone knows, hmu.
- in Robin's shop, the bike shed will still be labeled "Stable" - this is impossible to change without much deeper modding involving SNAPI, so I don't plan on trying to change it.

Installation: 
1) unzip file of your choice
2) back up your horse.xnb (found in Stardew Valley/Content/Animals), Blueprints.xnb (found in Stardew Valley/Content/Data), and stable.xnb (found in Stardew Valley/Content/Buildings) files.
3) replace them with the mod files

This is my first attempt at modding so if you have any advice/bugs, let me know! :)
